metadata.title: Cycloidal drive
metadata.motion: Phase is the canonical reference angle in radians. Column-major rigid/orbital transforms apply rotation about axis/pivot, then optional orbital translation R_orbit(center)-center. Strain-wave material deformation precedes its fixed matrix, including tangent-frame normal transport. Rates are radians per phase radian; deformation offsets are explicit.
metadata.scope: Housing, covers and the opaque output flange are hidden to expose the eccentric disc and output pins. Output pins and shaft retain their canonical motion. Actual sampled RatioLab geometry and nominal kinematics; no load or complete-cycle collision validation.
metadata.sourceHashScope: All Python and JSON inputs under the canonical src directory; hashes identify the exact local source snapshot, including any uncommitted changes.
